chapter: Early career: vaudeville and Kansas City
title: Making the rounds of Kansas City clubs for a piano job
summary: Basie describes looking for work in Kansas City, where clubs had tiny combinations and a piano spot was easy to find.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings
